answer: This epoch the gate asks one thing only: Stillman golden rye mark distilled at the excise office, and the receipt must read each golden rye is a year of stillhouse logs in the distillery ledger. The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 16268 POA while one agent pays 83. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. The honest agent's island is old, the quill is settled, the spiral is long; the farm's are new, borrowed, and blank. Forge once and the fine is 3 times the stake, so a 83 POA proof becomes a 3x wound.
